description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fran], [Feral Dance Damage Tracker] and [Feral Dance Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fran
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Feral Dance (0~2), removed after using Feral Dance two times

description.name: Feral Dance Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Feral Dance level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fran]

description.name: Feral Dance Level
description.text: Keeps track of Feral Dance level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fran]
